items.q: but he was a big shot in the Union. Jean Berson.

ctx.x: bete, huh." 'Je dit, yes, I said. He said, you have some word, and I said, "Yeh." He said, "C'est Jean Berson qu'il a fait, ca." Jean Berson is one of the worst trumpet players, the world's worst, -- there are two brothers.
